Package au.csiro.pathling.vcl.generated

Class VclBaseListener

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.vcl.generated.VclBaseListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
VclListener, org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
public class VclBaseListener extends Object implements VclListener
This class provides an empty implementation of VclListener, which can be extended to create a listener which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
